note: Governed keys referenced by element.expression. layout_primitive and interaction_primitive are seeded from the layout engine's first real .potx (astellas_v1, GEN607). Couturier v1 (2026-08-25) seeded a handful of style_ref + text_primitive look keys mapped from occurrence move — not a design system. Realizer v1 (2026-08-26) binds a closed compiler vocabulary onto text_primitive from atom kind + occurrence move (agents/realizer/primitives_v1.md): heading / body / step / callout / check. tp_step and tp_callout are the two keys that hop filled; heading/body/check reuse the existing look keys. motion_primitive remains empty (stub; not this hop). A registered key is the value an element carries in expression.*; layout keys also equal the layout-engine template_manifest layout id.

compiler_vocabulary.note: Tiny compiler form, not a design system. Realizer selects the text_primitive; Couturier still owns style_ref. tp_purpose is an existing objective look, not a sixth compiler role.

governance.rule: element.expression.* may only reference keys defined here. New keys require a version bump and an entry — the validator rejects anything else.
governance.naming: layout_primitive keys are UPPER_SNAKE and equal the layout-engine template_manifest layout id (decision 2026-07-31: layout-engine ids are canonical). interaction_primitive keys are lower_snake behavior names.

text_primitive.label: Display
text_primitive.description: Large opening type. Clothes for a hook — not body prose.

text_primitive.label: Body
text_primitive.description: Instructional prose. Clothes for present / activate / exemplify / transfer.

text_primitive.label: Purpose
text_primitive.description: Purpose-frame type. Clothes for an objective move.

text_primitive.label: Recall
text_primitive.description: Check / retrieval type. Clothes for reinforce (retrieve/retention) — a check the reader can attempt, not a quoted recap and not a first teaching. Compiler role: check.

text_primitive.label: Step
text_primitive.description: One line of a job sequence. Clothes for a procedure_step — a numbered job-aid item, not a body card of the SOP sentence. Compiler role: step.

text_primitive.label: Callout
text_primitive.description: Prior-knowledge / aside type. Clothes for activate. Compiler role: callout. Not on the ALSAP spine; filled so the closed set is honest.

layout_primitive.label: Title + Body
layout_primitive.description: Static title with a prose/bulleted body. Workhorse for low-complexity screens.

layout_primitive.label: Static 3-Card Set
layout_primitive.description: Title + intro + three peer cards, all visible. For a three-element peer set with no interaction.

layout_primitive.label: Click-to-Reveal Grid
layout_primitive.description: Prompt + grid of click-to-reveal cards with a gated Continue; each card lifts to a Storyline layer.

layout_primitive.label: Scenario Sort
layout_primitive.description: Stem + selectable option cards with per-choice feedback layers.

layout_primitive.label: Venn Diagram + Callouts
layout_primitive.description: Why-panel + 3-set venn + callouts. A convergence/overlap beat.

layout_primitive.label: Single-Best Knowledge Check
layout_primitive.description: Single-best multiple-choice knowledge check; the correct answer sets the section advancement variable.

interaction_primitive.label: Click to Reveal
interaction_primitive.description: Learner clicks each of N items to reveal its detail on a layer; progression may be gated until all are visited.

interaction_primitive.label: Scenario Select
interaction_primitive.description: Learner selects one or more option cards; each choice surfaces a per-choice feedback layer.

interaction_primitive.label: Single-Best MCQ
interaction_primitive.description: Single-best-answer multiple choice; the correct choice sets an advancement variable.

style_ref.label: Opening
style_ref.description: Attention/opening surface. Role, not a hex. Maps from move hook.

style_ref.label: Instructional
style_ref.description: Instructional body surface. Role, not a hex. Maps from move present.

style_ref.label: Recall
style_ref.description: Later-placement / retention surface. Role, not a hex. Maps from move reinforce (Gagné 9a retrieve).

style_ref.label: Purpose
style_ref.description: Purpose-frame surface. Maps from move objective.

style_ref.label: Prior knowledge
style_ref.description: Already-known callout. Maps from move activate.

style_ref.label: Example
style_ref.description: Named-example / citation surface. Maps from move exemplify.

style_ref.label: On the job
style_ref.description: Job-bridge surface. Maps from move transfer.
